description: Teleport anywhere inside the Dead Brands MCP in one call. Every district, place, Tower floor, game room, hub room, Library shelf and Grok Bot has a beacon; pass its id or name (e.g. 'library', 'arena', 'tower', 'rent-a-bot', 'pets', 'metro_rush', 'beacon-lib-mcp-dev'). Optional from = the beacon you start at (any beacon, incl. beacon-outsider-entrance and beacon-mcp-teleporter). Returns a tiny card (<500 tokens): where you are, 1-line blurb, next tools, cam, audio. Anonymous. Leaving for other MCP servers stays at hub_list_exits.

to.description: Destination beacon id or name, e.g. 'library', 'beacon-tower', 'metro_rush'.

name: hub_teleport
